correctness.rationale: Reconstructed and independently checked all normalized count weights and sector indices. For each fixed count difference, mutually disjoint left/right count sectors give an exact Schatten moment sum. Uniform binomial peak and overlap estimates plus Schatten triangle prove Z_alpha <= C t^(1/2-alpha). Contractive phase pinching to difference zero plus a local-CLT central window prove matching lower bound. Valid for every fixed real alpha>1 in infinite-volume-before-time limit. The 94 finite gate-level checks corroborate source inputs but are not used as infinite proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The source proves individual branch flatness plus pmax Theta(1/t), only forcing entropy between log t and alpha/(alpha-1) log t. Conversely the new theorem neither subsumes the von Neumann square-root law nor low-index linear rates.

value.rationale: The first unresolved quantitative question after the discovery of sqrt-von-Neumann versus logarithmic-high-index scaling is the precise high-index coefficient. This provides a nontrivial all-parameter curve and purity coefficient 3/2 for two explicitly motivated dynamics; it sharpens a provably nonsharp source interval and directly distinguishes coherent Schmidt effects without pretending to cover other gates.
